headline: Every week starts with a question. Pantry answers it on Monday.

figure.fits: Four words drawn in squares that warm up line by line, cold blue to the accent, the way a blank week fills up by Monday.

texts.text: **Monday at 8:** the week's plan lands in your inbox, so the first dinner is already decided.

notes.title: How
notes.text: Save the recipes you already cook. Pantry fills the week from them, uses up the leftovers first, and builds the shopping list.

notes.title: New ideas
notes.text: Ask for a suggestion and Pantry offers a few recipes that fit your week. Keep the ones you like and they join your recipes.
